answer: The prism schedule is applied in pulse and karst exposes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3621 identities would post 2316 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
